# Installing a cluster on {{ ibm_cloud_title }} into an existing VPC {#installing-ibm-cloud-vpc}

In OpenShift Container Platform version 4.22, you can install a cluster into an existing Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) on {{ ibm_cloud_name }}. The installation program provisions the rest of the required infrastructure, which you can further customize.
